records.name: Dignity of Womanhood
records.notes: Website https://dignityofwomanhood.com/ does not resolve (DNS lookup fails for both the bare and www names). One web search for the exact name plus Philadelphia found no Philadelphia group; the matches were an unrelated event in Connecticut and a podcast. Nothing could be confirmed about activities, so no summary, categories or interests were written. Held back on purpose. Retry with a corrected website or a social media page.

records.name: Elda Foundation for Women and Children
records.summary: A volunteer-led nonprofit that helps women and children in crisis with food, housing, and safety support in Philadelphia, and sends aid to Liberia.
records.what_you_do: Volunteers can help with food distribution, relocation support, social media, admin work, and fundraising, either on site in Philadelphia or from home.

cost.text: No fee to volunteer is listed on the site. Donations are optional.

first_step.how: Call 707-260-7808 and ask how to help with food distribution or relocation support in Philadelphia. The site has no sign-up form.
first_step.basis: Volunteer roles are listed, but the page gives no sign-up steps and the phone number is the only way in.

records.notes: The feed holds only two posts, both default 'Hello world!' posts from September 2024, so the newest dated item is 25 months old. The site lists 7106 Castor Ave, Philadelphia, PA 19149 as the address for checks; it is not confirmed as a program site, so no location is recorded. The email is listed as 'Coming soon'. Social links on the site are placeholders. Donation amounts were not recorded.

records.name: Finding My Way Foundation
records.summary: A nonprofit that runs life skills workshops for young adults ages 17 to 25 who identify as a minority, and shares resources to help them prepare for adult life.
records.what_you_do: Attend a life skills workshop listed on the Events or Programs pages, or sign up for the mailing list to hear about new ones.

first_step.how: Sign up for the mailing list from the homepage, then check the Events page for the next workshop.
first_step.basis: No workshop dates appear on the pages I could read, so the way in is the mailing list.

records.notes: No dated events or posts were found. The sitemap lists the events, programs and get-involved pages with one shared last-modified date (2025-12-09). That is a site update stamp, not an event date, so it is not used as a sign of life. The mailing list link is eepurl.com/iY6nqA. The events and programs pages were not read in full. The 'identify as a minority' limit is written in the summary because the audience list has no matching id. Verify the next workshop before relying on activity.

records.name: Gainesville Urban Farm
records.notes: The website https://www.gvilleurbnfarm.com/ shows only the hosting provider's default cPanel page, with no content. One web search for the name plus Philadelphia found no page for this group. No summary, categories or interests were written because nothing about its activities could be confirmed. Held back on purpose. Retry with a corrected website or a social media page.

records.name: Grace of Miqlat Ministries
records.summary: A church that calls itself a place of refuge. It holds worship and Bible study, runs a children's Bible group, and welcomes visitors from the neighborhood.
records.what_you_do: Visit for worship, come to the Thursday adult Bible study, or join a Tuesday or Saturday class, online or at Tacony Library.

schedule.text: Adult Bible study on Thursdays, 6 to 7 pm. A Tuesday Bible training class, 6 to 7 pm, meets online. Saturday children's classes, 3:30 to 4:30 pm, meet on Zoom at Tacony Library.

locations.label: Tacony Library (Saturday children's classes, per the church site)

cost.text: No fee is listed. The site invites donations to a literacy fund.

first_step.how: Call 215-780-0633 or email gracemiqlat@live.com to confirm the times, then come in for a visit.
first_step.basis: The church says visitors are welcome to come in for a visit and lists its weekly classes with times.

records.notes: Legal name is Grace of Miqlat International Ministries; the site calls it Grace of Miqlat Ministries. The schedule has no dates, so status rests on a working site with a current weekly schedule. The visit page gives only P.O. Box 17705, Philadelphia, PA 19135 and no street address, so no street location is recorded. The email is published on the church's own contact page. The site does not state a denomination, so faith is left blank. The New Life Bible Missionary Training School (Tuesday class) is named on the site and not checked as a separate lead.

records.name: Haitian-American United for Change
records.summary: A Philadelphia nonprofit that helps new immigrants, especially Haitian Americans, with English instruction, job search and business startup help, and immigration referrals.
records.what_you_do: Ask for help with English instruction, job search, or starting a business, or ask for a referral on an immigration question. The group also promotes Haitian culture.

cost.text: Fees and eligibility are not listed on the site.

first_step.how: Call (215) 681-8243 or use the contact page to ask about English instruction or job search help.
first_step.basis: The group serves new immigrants, but the site gives no intake steps, eligibility rules, or hours.

records.notes: The site lists a personal-looking Yahoo address as its email. It is not recorded because it is not clearly the group's own. No dated item with a month was found. The 2026 footer is not counted as evidence. The 'Second annual immigrant Holiday Party' has no date. The site gives no street address; the IRS record address (6059 Agusta St, 19149) is not confirmed by the site, so no location is recorded. The site lists English instruction, workforce training, client advocacy, job search and business startup help, and immigration referrals.

records.name: Holmesburg Amateur Radio Club
records.summary: A ham radio club that meets monthly, runs a weekly radio net, and supports public service radio work for the Philadelphia area.
records.what_you_do: Come to a monthly meeting (visitors are welcome), check into the Thursday evening radio net, or ask the club for radio support at a public event.

schedule.text: Monthly meeting on the third Wednesday at 7:30 pm. Weekly net on Thursdays at 8 pm on 146.685 MHz (PL 146.2). No meeting in June or July.

cost.text: Meetings and the net appear to be free. Dues are not listed on the site.

first_step.how: Come to a third Wednesday meeting at 7:30 pm (check the club page for the current month), or check into the Thursday 8 pm net on 146.685 MHz.
first_step.basis: The club says its meetings are open to all and visitors are welcome, and anyone can join the weekly net by radio.

records.notes: Legal name is Holmesburg Amateur Radio Club Inc. The site says the club has served the community 'since 1977' in one place and gives 1978 as its founding year in the body text. The club supports Philadelphia ARES, a BSA Troop 461 radio club, and collects stamps for a wounded veterans program; these are named leads and were not checked. The site has no street address or phone; it points to QRZ.com for the call sign address, so no location is recorded. Dated items: a March 2026 newsletter, June and July 2026 operating dates for special events, and a footer that reads 'Updated 7/6/26'. The August restaurant meeting and September Zoom meeting have no year on the page.

records.name: Hope and Help Network
records.notes: Verdict based on the site. Its only address is 1501 Huntingdon Road, Abington, PA 19001, which is outside the city. The site speaks of 'your community' and 'your neighbors' without naming a service area, and it never mentions Philadelphia. Its IRS record has an old Philadelphia address (3310 Decatur St, 19136) that the site does not mention. If evidence shows it serves Philadelphia residents, change this to publish. The site's 2025 year-end report and 2026 copyright were not used, since the record is out of area.

records.name: Hope for Africa One CDC
records.notes: The website hopeforafrica1.org fails the secure connection check: the server presents a certificate for a shared hosting provider rather than this domain (both the bare and www names were tried). The site could not be read, and no web search was spent on this group because the two available searches went to Gainesville Urban Farm and Dignity of Womanhood. No summary, categories or interests were written. Held back on purpose. Retry with a search or a corrected address.

records.name: IAmShe
records.summary: A nonprofit that encourages women going through life changes. It runs virtual gatherings and empowerment events, and offers one-on-one and group coaching.
records.what_you_do: Join a Single By Design virtual gathering on Zoom (held every third Thursday), attend an empowerment event, or sign up for the mailing list.

schedule.text: Single By Design virtual gathering on Zoom every third Thursday. The time is not given on the events page.

cost.text: Event prices are not listed on the events page.

first_step.how: Open the Details link for the next Single By Design gathering on the events page, or email info@iamshenikita.org to ask for the next date and time.
first_step.basis: Events have a Details link for registration, so the way in is clear, but the site does not say who the gatherings are for beyond women in transition.

records.notes: Legal name is IAmShe, Inc. The IRS name is 'I AM She: Someone He Empowered'. The site describes a life coaching practice as well as a nonprofit. It is recorded as publish because it runs group gatherings and events open to women. The newest dated item is the 'Adopt A Family 2024' donation campaign (December 17, 2024). The events list gives weekdays and month-day text without a year; those are not used. The homepage copyright is 2023 with no month. Location for in-person events is not published, and the 'Write To Freedom' release party venue is not given.

records.name: Kidz in Da Hood
records.summary: A Philadelphia nonprofit that mentors young people, runs after-school enrichment, and helps families in need through community outreach.
records.what_you_do: Sign up for youth mentorship, leadership training, or after-school enrichment through the Register Now form, or call to ask about a start date.

cost.text: No program fees or donation amounts are listed on the site.

first_step.how: Use the Register Now form on the homepage, or call 267-768-7738 to ask when sessions start.
first_step.basis: Joining means filling in a registration form, and the site gives no schedule, age range, or description of a session.

records.notes: No dated events or posts were found. The footer is a 2026 copyright, which is not counted as evidence. The menu item 'Upcoming Events' links to kidzindahood.org/upcoming-events, which was not fetched because the per-site fetch limit was reached. Check that page before relying on status. The /contact-us and /events pages returned 404. The site gives Philadelphia only, with no street address, so no location is recorded. Legal name is Kidz In Da Hood Inc.

records.name: Lifting the Burden
records.notes: A donor-funded program that sends comfort bears to hospitals and other groups. The site offers only two routes in: sponsoring a bear or donating, and an email list. It has no volunteer, attend, or membership route and no dated events, so it is hidden under the no public way in rule. Revisit if the group opens volunteer or program sign-ups.

records.name: North East Services Team
records.summary: A group of Northeast Philadelphia organizations that connects neighbors to services. It runs a free produce pickup every Wednesday afternoon at Hamilton Disston School.
records.what_you_do: Pick up free produce on Wednesdays, use the resource directory to find services, or ask how to take part through the contact page.

schedule.text: Free produce pickup every Wednesday, 2:30 to 3:30 pm, at Hamilton Disston School

first_step.how: Go to Hamilton Disston School on a Wednesday between 2:30 and 3:30 pm to pick up produce. For other questions, use the contact form on the group's site.
first_step.basis: The weekly pickup is listed as open to residents, and the site describes no sign-up step.

records.notes: Mailing address is PO Box 28450, Philadelphia, PA 19149. The site has a contact form only; no phone or email is published. The produce pickup has a weekday and time but no dates. The homepage has no dated items; the webinar series is undated, and the uniform drive is labeled as past with no date. Status rests on a working site with a current weekly schedule. The street address of the school is not on the site. The Facebook page was linked and not read.

records.name: Oxford Circle Christian Community Development Association
records.summary: A faith-based nonprofit in the Oxford Circle neighborhood. It runs an after-school and summer camp, adult education and job training, family resource centers, and food distribution.
records.what_you_do: Enroll a child in the after-school or summer camp, take an adult education or workforce class, get help at a family resource center, or volunteer through the Volunteer Today page.

cost.text: Program costs are not listed on the site.

first_step.how: Call (215) 288-8504 or email contact@occcda.org to ask about after-school or summer camp enrollment, or use the Volunteer Today page to help out.
first_step.basis: The site lists programs but gives no eligibility, enrollment steps, or hours, so you have to call or email to find out.

records.notes: Legal name is Oxford Circle Christian Communitydevelopment Association Inc, as spelled on the IRS record. The events page lists no dated events. Its 'Recent News' items have no dates (commercial space for rent, an anniversary celebration, three job postings), and the donor recognition event has no date. The only year on the site is 'Oxford Circle CCDA Summer Camp 2021' in a menu label, with no month. Status is probably_active because the site is working and lists current programs, but no dated item newer than 2021 was found. Eligibility for programs is not stated. The IRS record shows Unit B for the address; the site does not.

records.name: Pilgrims Vision International Church
records.summary: A Christian church with a Philadelphia campus and a second campus in Chalfont, PA. It offers Sunday worship, small groups, kids and youth ministry, and a Wednesday night Bible study.
records.what_you_do: Come to Sunday worship at the Philadelphia campus, join a small group, or bring kids to the kids and youth ministry. First-time visitors can start on the I'm new here page.

schedule.text: Sunday worship at 10 am at the Philadelphia campus. A Wednesday night Bible study is linked from the site, with no time shown.

cost.text: No cost is listed. The site has a giving link.

first_step.how: Choose the Philadelphia campus on the site, read the I'm new here page, or call 215-660-9723 or email pvicphiladelphia@gmail.com before a Sunday.
first_step.basis: The church has a welcome path for new visitors and invites them to small groups and Sunday services.

records.notes: The newest dated items on the site are a sermon and blog posts from April to September 2022, and the 'Upcoming Events' section is empty. The earlier liveness check listed 2024-06, which I could not confirm: the sitemap shows no post dated 2024. The Chalfont campus is outside Philadelphia and is not in this location. The site gives the Philadelphia Sunday service as 10 pm in one place and 10 am in another; 10 am is used here. Legal name is Pilgrims Vision Inc.

blocked.note: Domain does not resolve (DNS lookup fails for bare and www names).
Secure connection fails: the server presents a shared hosting certificate for another domain (bare and www names). Site not readable.

notes: Budget: both WebSearch calls were used, on Gainesville Urban Farm (no match) and Dignity of Womanhood (no Philadelphia match), so Hope for Africa One CDC got no search. 30 WebFetch calls in total, within the two extra pages per site rule. No rate limiting seen; failures were DNS and TLS errors. Three IRS groups (Dignity of Womanhood, Gainesville Urban Farm, Hope for Africa One CDC) are unknown and held back with no summary, categories or interests. Status method: a working site with no dated item is probably_active, at low confidence; a newest dated item older than 24 months is dormant (Elda Foundation, Pilgrims Vision). Hope and Help Network is out_of_area because its only address is in Abington and the site never names Philadelphia; reverse it if evidence of Philadelphia service turns up. Kidz in Da Hood's Upcoming Events page was linked but not fetched. Grace of Miqlat and Pilgrims Vision are churches with faith left blank where the site gives no denomination. Named but unchecked leads with no URL: Philadelphia ARES (named on the Holmesburg Amateur Radio Club site).
